per_step_blocks.name: root_relative_positions
per_step_blocks.semantics: target body position minus previous reference root position, rotated by previous reference root heading inverse

per_step_blocks.name: body_delta_rotations

open_questions: The original ProtoMotions checkpoint, smpl.yaml, motion-tracker config, and exact preprocessing implementation are not all present and pinned in this checkout.
Current UE future poses are derived from Pose Search asset sampling and Manny-to-SMPL canonical adaptation; exact equivalence to the training motion_lib data frame is not yet proven end to end.
The authoritative original action normalization and PD target-range transform must be verified against the checkpoint configuration rather than inferred from current runtime behavior.
The selected animation's root-motion frame, canonical Proto root frame, and current physical-body frame require a permanent end-to-end synthetic-vector parity test.
Animation-end clamping shortens future_time values near clip end; parity with the training sampler's wrapping or clipping behavior is unresolved.
